headline: A rare harbourside setting in Kirribilli
body: 34 Jeffreys Street is an elevated terrace with harbour outlooks, set on 158sqm with four bedrooms, four bathrooms and parking for two cars.
Harbourside settings like this are rarely offered in Kirribilli. With 42 Jeffreys Street recently sold a few doors along, Saturday is the time to see it in person.
We look forward to seeing you there.
